card.name: Section and footnote labels in drug labels
card.fires_on: Single-character labels that start a new item in a drug label: the period in section numbers like 5.6 or 7.3, and a lone letter such as A, c or e that begins a list item or table footnote.

modes.label: Dot in section number
modes.description: The period between digits in a numbered label heading, right before the section title.

modes.description: A single letter that opens a list entry or footnote after a colon, semicolon or sentence end.
